column1: # Official Juniper MIB bundles (public, no login): Juniper's SNMP MIB Explorer download service,
# fetch.sh downloads each archive, verifies sha256 and extracts it into corpus/src/juniper-official/<dir>/.
# Newest release as of 2026-10-10: Junos OS 26.2R1 (file 26.2R1.7) and Junos OS Evolved 26.2R1 (26.2R1.7-EVO).
# The (older) www.juniper.net/documentation/software/junos/junosNNN/juniper-mibs-<rel>.zip URLs exist only up to 25.4R1.
# Licence: Juniper's MIB files carry Juniper copyright notices; never commit their texts (only these pins/hashes).
